tiers.name: Light
tiers.fits: Small, one session, no plan needed

tiers.name: Full
tiers.fits: Needs a plan, or too big for one session

stages.name: Plan
stages.text: What it is for, how big, how risky; a tier proposed.

stages.name: Build
stages.text: Small steps, each checked before the next.

stages.name: Ship
stages.text: I accept and ship; nothing promotes itself.

costLimits.counted: Tests that back no acceptance claim, and tests that duplicate one that already backs a claim
costLimits.atLimit: Each one becomes a trade-off for me: the test, what it adds beyond the claim's own test, and its upkeep

costLimits.counted: Guards for paths that are not security findings, as Cost limits defines them
costLimits.atLimit: Reported as an accepted-risk candidate; never built unasked
The rest listed as notes in the review's record; I pick which to file

costLimits.counted: Lens pairs run in one review round; a lens offered alone counts as a pair
costLimits.atLimit: The next pair becomes a trade-off for me: which pair it would replace, and what it would check

costLimits.counted: Review rounds at one stage, a spec or Test, follow-ups and closing reads included; a ticket cut from an approved spec gets no spec round of its own
costLimits.atLimit: A new low is noted in the review's record or filed; a new medium becomes a trade-off for me; a high security finding reopens the stage
